question: With regard to the forthcoming EU-Uzbekistan Partnership and Cooperation Agreement, what conditionalities will be contained therein regarding Karakalpakstan, such as its socioeconomic marginalisation, an independent investigation into the events of 1-2 July 2022 and the ongoing detention of Dauletmurat Tazhimuratov, which was found to be in breach of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights by the UN Working Group on Arbitrary Detention at its 101st session held from 11 to 15 November 2024?
